name: (05) Thaumaturgy (Oneiromancy) — 3 Advanced — Reveal the Heart's Dreams

system.description: By observing a target within sight and winning a Mental Challenge (spending one Willpower Trait for a mortal target or two for a Kindred target), the oneiromancer learns the target's single guiding passion or greatest fear. This knowledge goes to the very core of the target's soul, allowing the caster to make an offer nearly impossible to refuse or a threat that may trigger frenzy. This power requires the presence of a Storyteller or Narrator to provide results, and requires at least five minutes of dreamlike trance beforehand.
